verdict.rationale: Auth0's log streaming service lets developers export tenant logs (which include auth events like logins) to external analysis services, providing a mechanism to keep systems in sync with auth events, but the evidence never explicitly mentions webhooks, per-event subscriptions, or a dedicated event-streaming API for sign-ups/sign-ins/user changes. missing for 10: explicit webhook subscription API, granular event-type filtering (sign-up vs sign-in vs user-change), and independent developer confirmation that log streams reliably substitute for webhooks.
